head.text: BAD PERF -- refresh storm. With tREFI cranked down, every refresh costs PREA + REF + tRFC and closes every open row, so the next access is a guaranteed page miss too. w_rfc_busy blocks ACT and REF alike. Board sweep: fast_refresh vs slow_refresh is the axis that isolates this; the cost is roughly tRFC/tREFI of the bus plus the re-activation of every row it closed.
